name: optcatalog_clear_runtime_instances
description: OptCatalog::ClearRuntimeInstances detaches an entry's active runtime list and recycles every runtime instance.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent OptCatalog runtime-instance source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4aebc0 validates loading entry->activeRuntimeListHead, clearing the entry head before iteration, saving each runtime's next pointer before calling OptCatalog::RecycleRuntimeInstance, and looping until null.

The native OptCatalog runtime free-list smoke verifies a two-runtime active list is cleared from the entry, both projectile nodes are detached from the runtime world, and both runtime storages are returned to the free list.
